audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of thirty ExtraDialogue records covering every Morris greeting and membership state, both Community Development Form gender variants, and the first seventeen purchased-item reactions. Every response branch, placeholder, price, organization and building term, quality judgment, food description, NPC-specific memory, and control marker was reviewed against its key context and the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Keys, placeholders, response identifiers, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, and non-text payloads were preserved. Remaining ExtraDialogue records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
